主要内容: The document titled 'm2271206k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing is dated February 27, 2012, and is related to the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, with a principal amount of $27,000,000. The notes are due on February 27, 2017, and were priced on February 22, 2012. The filing includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian, Ontario, Quebec, and New York law. The document is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s Registration Statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The filing is signed by two authorized officers of the Bank on February 27, 2012.
